paragraphs.text: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
paragraphs.original: Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ χριστὸς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν γεννήσαντα ἀγαπᾷ καὶ τὸν γεγεννημένον ἐξ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Pas ho pisteuōn hoti Iēsous estin ho christos ek tou theou gegennētai, kai pas ho agapōn ton gennēsanta agapa kai ton gegennēmenon ex autou.

paragraphs.text: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅταν τὸν θεὸν ἀγαπῶμεν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ποιῶμεν·
paragraphs.translit: en toutō ginōskomen hoti agapōmen ta tekna tou theou, hotan ton theon agapōmen kai tas entolas autou poiōmen·

paragraphs.text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
paragraphs.original: αὕτη γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν, καὶ αἱ ἐντολαὶ αὐτοῦ βαρεῖαι οὐκ εἰσίν,
paragraphs.translit: hautē gar estin hē agapē tou theou hina tas entolas autou tērōmen, kai hai entolai autou bareiai ouk eisin,

paragraphs.text: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, [even] our faith.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ νικᾷ τὸν κόσμον. καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ νίκη ἡ νικήσασα τὸν κόσμον, ἡ πίστις ἡμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: hoti pan to gegennēmenon ek tou theou nika ton kosmon. kai hautē estin hē nikē hē nikēsasa ton kosmon, hē pistis hēmōn·

paragraphs.text: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
paragraphs.original: τίς δέ ἐστιν ὁ νικῶν τὸν κόσμον εἰ μὴ ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ;
paragraphs.translit: tis de estin ho nikōn ton kosmon ei mē ho pisteuōn hoti Iēsous estin ho hyios tou theou;

paragraphs.text: This is he that came by water and blood, [even] Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood.
paragraphs.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἐλθὼν διʼ ὕδατος καὶ αἵματος, Ἰησοῦς Χριστός· οὐκ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι μόνον ἀλλʼ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι καὶ ἐν τῷ αἵματι· καὶ τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ μαρτυροῦν, ὅτι τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν ἡ ἀλήθεια.
paragraphs.translit: Houtos estin ho elthōn diʼ hydatos kai haimatos, Iēsous Christos· ouk en tō hydati monon allʼ en tō hydati kai en tō haimati· kai to pneuma estin to martyroun, hoti to pneuma estin hē alētheia.

paragraphs.text: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι τρεῖς εἰσιν οἱ μαρτυροῦντες,
paragraphs.translit: hoti treis eisin hoi martyrountes,

paragraphs.text: For there are three who bear witness, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and the three agree in one.
paragraphs.original: τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ τὸ αἷμα, καὶ οἱ τρεῖς εἰς τὸ ἕν εἰσιν.
paragraphs.translit: to pneuma kai to hydōr kai to haima, kai hoi treis eis to hen eisin.

paragraphs.text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for the witness of God is this, that he hath borne witness concerning his Son.
paragraphs.original: εἰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων λαμβάνομεν, ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ θεοῦ μείζων ἐστίν, ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ θεοῦ ὅτι μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ei tēn martyrian tōn anthrōpōn lambanomen, hē martyria tou theou meizōn estin, hoti hautē estin hē martyria tou theou hoti memartyrēken peri tou hyiou autou.

paragraphs.text: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in him: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed in the witness that God hath borne concerning his Son.
paragraphs.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἔχει τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐν αὑτῷ· ὁ μὴ πιστεύων τῷ θεῷ ψεύστην πεποίηκεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὐ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἣν μεμαρτύρηκεν ὁ θεὸς περὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho pisteuōn eis ton hyion tou theou echei tēn martyrian en hautō· ho mē pisteuōn tō theō pseustēn pepoiēken auton, hoti ou pepisteuken eis tēn martyrian hēn memartyrēken ho theos peri tou hyiou autou.

paragraphs.text: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία, ὅτι ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῖν, καὶ αὕτη ἡ ζωὴ ἐν τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hautē estin hē martyria, hoti zōēn aiōnion edōken ho theos hēmin, kai hautē hē zōē en tō hyiō autou estin.

paragraphs.text: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ἔχων τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει τὴν ζωήν· ὁ μὴ ἔχων τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν ζωὴν οὐκ ἔχει.
paragraphs.translit: ho echōn ton hyion echei tēn zōēn· ho mē echōn ton hyion tou theou tēn zōēn ouk echei.

paragraphs.text: These things have I written unto you, that ye may know that ye have eternal life, [even] unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἵνα εἰδῆτε ὅτι ζωὴν ἔχετε αἰώνιον, τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta egrapsa hymin hina eidēte hoti zōēn echete aiōnion, tois pisteuousin eis to onoma tou hyiou tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ παρρησία ἣν ἔχομεν πρὸς αὐτόν, ὅτι ἐάν τι αἰτώμεθα κατὰ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ἀκούει ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hautē estin hē parrēsia hēn echomen pros auton, hoti ean ti aitōmetha kata to thelēma autou akouei hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: and if we know that he heareth us whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐὰν οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀκούει ἡμῶν ὃ ἐὰν αἰτώμεθα, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἔχομεν τὰ αἰτήματα ἃ ᾐτήκαμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ean oidamen hoti akouei hēmōn ho ean aitōmetha, oidamen hoti echomen ta aitēmata ha ētēkamen apʼ autou.

paragraphs.text: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and [God] will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.
paragraphs.original: ἐάν τις ἴδῃ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτάνοντα ἁμαρτίαν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον, αἰτήσει, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ ζωήν, τοῖς ἁμαρτάνουσιν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον. ἔστιν ἁμαρτία πρὸς θάνατον· οὐ περὶ ἐκείνης λέγω ἵνα ἐρωτήσῃ.
paragraphs.translit: ean tis idē ton adelphon autou hamartanonta hamartian mē pros thanaton, aitēsei, kai dōsei autō zōēn, tois hamartanousin mē pros thanaton. estin hamartia pros thanaton· ou peri ekeinēs legō hina erōtēsē.

paragraphs.text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
paragraphs.original: πᾶσα ἀδικία ἁμαρτία ἐστίν, καὶ ἔστιν ἁμαρτία οὐ πρὸς θάνατον.
paragraphs.translit: pasa adikia hamartia estin, kai estin hamartia ou pros thanaton.

paragraphs.text: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.
paragraphs.original: Οἴδαμεν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει, ἀλλʼ ὁ γεννηθεὶς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τηρεῖ αὐτόν, καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς οὐχ ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Oidamen hoti pas ho gegennēmenos ek tou theou ouch hamartanei, allʼ ho gennētheis ek tou theou tērei auton, kai ho ponēros ouch haptetai autou.

paragraphs.text: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.
paragraphs.original: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐσμεν, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ὅλος ἐν τῷ πονηρῷ κεῖται.
paragraphs.translit: oidamen hoti ek tou theou esmen, kai ho kosmos holos en tō ponērō keitai.

paragraphs.text: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
paragraphs.original: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἥκει, καὶ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν διάνοιαν ἵνα γινώσκωμεν τὸν ἀληθινόν· καὶ ἐσμὲν ἐν τῷ ἀληθινῷ, ἐν τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ. οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀληθινὸς θεὸς καὶ ζωὴ αἰώνιος.
paragraphs.translit: oidamen de hoti ho hyios tou theou hēkei, kai dedōken hēmin dianoian hina ginōskōmen ton alēthinon· kai esmen en tō alēthinō, en tō hyiō autou Iēsou Christō. houtos estin ho alēthinos theos kai zōē aiōnios.

paragraphs.text: [My] little children, guard yourselves from idols.
paragraphs.original: Τεκνία, φυλάξατε ἑαυτὰ ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων.
paragraphs.translit: Teknia, phylaxate heauta apo tōn eidōlōn.
